text: The Patriots face the Jaguars this Sunday with notable roster shuffling in their linebacker corps: OLB Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and OLB Quintayvious Hutchins (knee) are ruled out, with the team placing rookie LB Hutchins on injured reserve, while CB Carlton Davis III is set to return from injury. On the positive injury front, rookie TE Eli Raridon has returned to practice, offering an encouraging sign as the team monitors his status for Jacksonville. Beyond the health report, beat writers are highlighting a concerning pattern in the Patriots' game management, specifically pointing to questionable decisions before halftime in their last two contests—something the team has acknowledged needs immediate improvement heading into Week 3. Meanwhile, the Jaguars are expecting a favorable matchup against a Patriots team they perceive as still "finding ourselves," banking on a strong offensive response after their worst performance in eleven months.
